Today, our esteemed guest is a member of Congress who introduced legislation to help family members in this way. Representative Jim Banks Republican from Indiana sits on the House Armed Services Committee. So he thinks about these issues. Congressman, thank you so much for your time. And we are very pleased to have you join us to talk about efforts in helping military families.
